name: Midnight Sun Fire Celebration at Patscherkofel
beschreibung: Celebrate the summer solstice on the Patscherkofel high above Innsbruck. A blazing solstice bonfire, music, and local delicacies accompany the longest day of the year. The panoramic view from 2,000 metres across the alpine peaks glowing in the evening light is truly unforgettable.
kurzbeschreibung: Solstice bonfires and celebration on the Patscherkofel – the longest day of the year with dream views over Innsbruck.
